entities.name: GOLPH3
observations: High expression was associated with worse overall and disease-free survival in primary human hepatocellular carcinoma cohorts.
Independent overall-survival prediction was reported in a separate 180-sample HCC study.

entities.name: Hepatocellular carcinoma
observations: Primary human studies evaluated GOLPH3 expression as a prognostic biomarker for overall and disease-free survival.

entities.name: PMID:24867097
observations: In 167 paraffin-embedded HCC samples, high GOLPH3 expression was associated with OS HR 1.87 (95% CI 1.19–2.94; P=0.006) and DFS HR 1.90 (95% CI 1.21–2.98; P=0.005); multivariable Cox analysis identified GOLPH3, tumor size, and tumor multiplicity as independent prognostic predictors.

entities.name: PMID:25090263
observations: A PubMed record/report appears to reproduce the same GOLPH3 HCC survival results as PMID:24867097; it should not be counted as an independent cohort without full-text verification.

entities.name: PMID:25634514
observations: In 180 HCC samples, high GOLPH3 independently predicted poor overall survival: HR 2.01 (95% CI 1.26–3.64; P=0.025). The available abstract did not report DFS/RFS or the full covariate set.

entities.name: PMID:25385148
observations: GOLPH3 expression correlated with clinical stage and survival in testing and validation HCC cohorts, but the available abstract gave no hazard ratio and did not establish independent prediction by multivariable analysis.
